text: My daily routine is built on consistency, which helps me stay productive and relaxed. I wake up at six-thirty each morning and start with a glass of water and a short meditation. After a light breakfast, I begin work at nine, focusing on my main tasks before lunch. In the afternoon, I take a quick break to exercise, usually a twenty-minute walk or some stretching. This keeps my energy up for the rest of the day. Evenings are for winding down: I cook dinner, read a few pages of a book, and prepare my clothes for the next day. By ten, I am ready for bed, feeling calm and satisfied.
